summary: Completed frontend-only testing of Formula Management Module improvements. All requested features verified working correctly: Parameters tab shows User Input/Predefined tags, Add Parameter dialog has Value Source radio buttons with Predefined dropdown, Add Formula dialog shows Available Parameters from database API (not hardcoded), and Formula Components support operation selection (×, ÷, +, −).

issues: Minor console warning: HTML hydration error with <span> inside <select> - non-blocking issue from previous iteration, should be cleaned up

parameters_tab_tags.details: Parameters tab shows 'User Input' (blue badge) and 'Predefined' (green badge) tags for each parameter. Stats show: 5 Total Parameters, 1 User Input, 4 Predefined, 1 Conversions

add_parameter_value_source_radio.details: Add Parameter dialog has 'Value Source' section with two radio button options: 'User Input' and 'Predefined Value'. Radio buttons are styled with border highlighting when selected.

predefined_value_dropdown.details: When 'Predefined Value' is selected, dropdown appears with options: Fuel Database (Calorific Value, CO₂/CH₄/N₂O Emission Factors, Density) and GWP values (CO₂=1, CH₄=28, N₂O=273)

add_formula_available_parameters_from_ap.details: Add Formula dialog shows Available Parameters populated from database API (not hardcoded): Quantity of Fuel, Net Calorific value, emission factor on basis of heat, Density of Liquid fuel, Density of gas fuel

formula_components_operation_selection.details: Formula Components section shows operation dropdown (×, ÷, +, −) for each component except the first (which is marked as 'Base'). Operations: multiply, divide, add, subtract

formula_expression_updates_with_operatio.details: Formula Expression preview updates dynamically when operations are changed. Tested changing multiply to divide - expression shows correct symbol (÷)

backend_predefined_source_field.details: Backend API /api/super-admin/formula-parameters correctly accepts and returns predefined_source field (e.g., 'fuel_database.co2_emission_factor')

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Formulas.js line ~564-567 uses AlertCircle icon but import is not visible in provided code - may need verification
Minor: Console hydration warning for <span> inside <select> persists from earlier - non-blocking but should be addressed for console hygiene
seed_data_creation: Test parameter created and cleaned up during API verification

Existing data: 5 parameters (1 User Input, 4 Predefined), 1 formula (Scope 1).
